meta.name: autonomous-investigation
meta.description: The protocol behind every investigation skill. Use when AI research must proceed without you: search-plan gate, Fact/Inference/Assumption labels, confidence stacking, diffable outputs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI研究自动进行，无需人工介入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要AI自主完成多步骤调研并输出结构化结果
copy.tagline_en: Let AI research proceed without manual intervention
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to autonomously conduct multi-step research and output structured results

howto.what: Claude 接手后不再逐题问你就直接做调查:先列出 3 条搜索计划,把每条关键结论标注为事实、推断或假设,只附可核实链接和日期,用固定版式输出,最后给出 4 个下一步选项。
howto.when: 当调查需要无人值守地推进时触发,典型如你给出调查目标和要支持的决策,要求 Claude 自主研究,或定时、后台运行调查任务。

say.text: 调查[目标公司]最近的定价调整,支撑我们下季度的定价策略。
say.note: Claude 会先展示搜索计划,再标注证据等级。

say.text: 对[行业]做一次自主竞争扫描,输出可对比上季度的固定版式报告。
say.note: 中途不必回答,它会用假设补齐缺口。

say.text: 查一下[目标]的招聘信息,判断其是否在转向 AI 方向,并标注推断。
say.note: 会区分事实和推断,不编造来源。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude proceeds without asking you each question: shows a 3-bullet search plan, labels each key claim Fact/Inference/Assumption, attaches checkable URLs and dates, outputs in a fixed layout, and ends with 4 next-step options.
howto.when_en: Triggers when research must proceed without you, such as when you give a target and the decision it supports and ask Claude to investigate autonomously, or when a scheduled or background investigation runs.

say_en.text: Investigate [target company]'s recent pricing changes to support our next-quarter pricing decision.
say_en.note: Claude shows the plan first, then labels evidence levels.

say_en.text: Check [target]'s job posts to see if they are shifting to AI, and label inferences.
say_en.note: It separates facts from inferences and does not invent sources.
